units.source_text: 那天的谈话到此为止，就没有再说下去。

en.t: That day's conversation ended there, and we did not go any further.

units.source_text: 我对先生的态度多少有点害怕，也不敢再往下说了。

en.t: I was somewhat intimidated by Sensei's attitude, and did not dare to continue.

units.source_text: 我们从市郊坐上电车，在车上几乎没有说话。

en.t: We boarded a streetcar on the outskirts of the city and hardly spoke while we were on it.

units.source_text: 下车后没走两步就该分手了。

en.t: After we got off, we had barely walked a few steps before it was time to part.

units.source_text: 分手时，先生的态度又变了，比往常都愉快地对我说：

en.t: When we parted, Sensei's manner changed again, and he spoke to me more cheerfully than usual:

units.source_text: “从现在到六月是你最轻松的日子，说不定是你一生中最轻松的时候呢，痛痛快快地去玩吧。”

en.t: "From now until June will be your most carefree days; they may even be the most carefree time of your whole life. Go and enjoy yourself thoroughly."
I smiled and took off my hat.

units.source_text: 那时我望着先生的脸，不禁心中疑惑：先生真的在心里憎恨所有的人吗？

en.t: At that moment, looking at Sensei's face, I could not help wondering: did he truly hate everyone in his heart?

units.source_text: 他的眼神、他的嘴角，一点都没有显露出厌世的影子啊！

en.t: In his eyes and at the corners of his mouth, there was not the slightest trace of world-weariness.

units.source_text: 在思想方面，我受到了先生的不少教诲。

en.t: In matters of thought, I received a great deal of instruction from Sensei.

units.source_text: 但是，对于同样的问题，即使我想要得到教诲，却往往得不到。

en.t: But with regard to those same questions, even when I wanted instruction, I often could not obtain it.

units.source_text: 先生讲话时常使人不得要领，那天我们在郊外的谈话，便是让我记忆犹新的一个例子。

en.t: Sensei's remarks often left one unable to grasp the point, and our conversation in the suburbs that day remained in my memory as one vivid example.

units.source_text: 有一天，我终于不客气地当着先生面讲了出来。

en.t: One day, I finally spoke of it frankly to Sensei's face.

units.source_text: “我脑子迟钝，搞不明白，这没有关系，

en.t: "It does not matter if my mind is dull and I cannot understand,

units.source_text: 我最头痛的是，您明明知道，却不明白地告诉我。”

en.t: what troubles me most is that you clearly know, yet you do not explain it plainly to me."
"I am not hiding anything at all."
